Haveli Baisa
Johari Bazaar, Jaipur
Rupees. Breakfast is included.

Folio HB-22917 for Priya Menon.
She arrived April 2, 2026. The desk stamp reads April 2, 2026 2:30 pm.
The stay is 4 nights, and the morning she leaves is not stamped.

Noted on the stay: airport pickup and a heritage walk.
Room Sheesh Mahal, nightly 6,480.25.
City tax of 412.80 is printed on the folio.
The nightly rate and the night count are both here, and the room was never extended.
Channel reference MM-88301 held 2,418.90 outside this folio.

depart_on.instruction: Arrival date plus the night count

text: Kairali on the next berth showed 53 boxes. Backwater flat, crows already on the crates. oil sardine, Indian mackerel, pearl spot. Peter Mathew at the Kochi fishery jetty. Skipper Raju brought Mariya Puthu in, sailed 27 Feb 2026, boxes under the hammer 2026-03-16. Gross on the slate 6400. Ice and jetty together 875.

species.instruction: Each kind of fish that came off the boat

auction_on.instruction: Date the boxes went under the hammer

landing_net.instruction: Auction gross after ice and jetty are taken off

days_at_sea.instruction: Days from sailing to the auction

text: The bistro in Manchester was short an evening line cook, so the manager wrote down annual figures people had said out loud, before tax and without the service share. A cook from Leeds named 27350 and someone already on the pass expected 24800. The agency floated 28600, and a hire just off a cruise ship said 26100, with no signature under any of it.

estimate.instruction: Give one annual salary in pounds from the middle of the figures the manager wrote down.

place.instruction: Which city is the bistro in?

text: Bay Dental, Crwys Road, Cardiff. Owen Briggs: the crown on UL6 went in on 2026-03-09. This review text is 4 Apr 2026. Bring the night guard and the bite record. Lab came to 214.65 and chair time to 308.90. No NHS number is held on the private card. Sister file DP-5582 stays off this thread. A declined quote of 486 is in the paper tray.

patient.instruction: Patient this review text is about

to_bring.instruction: Each item Owen is told to bring

fees_together.instruction: Lab fee and chair time added together

days_since_crown.instruction: Days from fitting the crown to this SMS

nhs_number.instruction: NHS number held on the private card
